packages/core/src/handoff/run-resume.ts.message: `--path` may select a sibling handoff, but this still attaches a record from the current root. It can claim that local record is newer than the selected newer sibling SESSION doc.

packages/core/src/handoff/precompact.ts.message: Git collection can run seven serial 5s calls before writing. A slow repo can hold PreCompact for ~35s and miss its hook timeout, leaving no record.
